title: Mishy Mash Smash
style: Pop-rock with bouncy mid-tempo four-on-the-floor, rubbery bass, clipped electric guitars, and handclap accents; verse rides on tight drums and playful stabs, pre-chorus strips to bass and snapped vocals, chorus hits with stacked gang doubles and a shoutable hook. Add tape-stop fills, bounce-back delay throws, and a bright, punchy radio mix with close-mic lead vocal.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Michelle at the fence line
Sneakers on the blacktop
Dink, then a quick grin
You never let the pace stop

Paddle in your right hand
Hair tied up high
You read my weak shot
Like you already knew why

[Pre-Chorus]
Game point pressure
You stay so cool
One small bounce
Then you break the rules

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Yeah, Michelle)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
You make that net flash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Back, back, back)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
And you never hit the brakes

[Verse 2]
Orange cone court chalk
Sweat on your wristband
You call out "mine" fast
Then you own the backhand

I tried to play clever
You played it mean
Little cross-court magic
Straight through the seam

[Pre-Chorus]
Crowd starts humming
Feet start to slide
You lock that look in
And let it ride

[Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Yeah, Michelle)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
You make that net flash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Back, back, back)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
And you never hit the brakes

[Bridge]
Tie-break tension
You smile at me
One last serve
Then it’s history

[Final Chorus]
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Yeah, Michelle)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
You make that net flash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
(Back, back, back)
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
Michelle mishy mish mash pickle ball smash
